overview: 9 of 9, no wipes, 25 deaths, 16 of them on bosses. The Twin Emperors went down in 2:09, twenty seconds under the guild's best (2:29) and half the usual 4:04, and Ouro (1:13) equalled the guild record. Princess Huhuran (0:34) was a second off hers.
Viscidus was the slow one: 2:02 against a usual 1:59 and a best of 1:33, with 9 of the night's 16 boss deaths. C'Thun took 3:59 against a usual 5:16, with 6 deaths and four Rebirths during the fight.

World buffs: none on anyone at Skeram and only one raider at Viscidus, while 39 of 40 had Rallying Cry and Zandalar on the other bosses. That pattern is the usual sign of buffs stored in a Chronoboon for those two.
